title: Ergopti+ tap-hold configuration (shared)
description: JSON Schema for windows/data/tap_hold/defaults.toml AND for the AHK driver's complete tap-hold configuration under config/ergopti_plus/ahk/tap_hold.toml. The per-driver file is seeded once from the driver-local defaults at first boot and then owned by the user — there is no runtime merge.

keys_map.description: Map of physical-key names to tap-hold configuration.

enabled.description: Defaults to true. Set false to disable this tap-hold without removing the section.

time_activation_seconds.description: Hold threshold in seconds. Below = tap_action; above = hold_*.

tap_action.description: Action emitted on tap. Reference to _shared/actions.toml entry or a key name.

hold_layer.description: Layer activated while held. Reference to a tap_hold.layers.<name> key.

allOf.description: hold_layer and hold_modifier are mutually exclusive.

description_key.description: i18n key used for the menu label. Resolved against static/locales/<lang>.json.

mappings.description: Map of source key → action or destination key. Action strings reference _shared/actions.toml.
